mapper.select: SELECT lat.late_id, emp.emp_id, CONCAT(emp.emp_lname, ' ', emp.emp_fname) AS emp_name, lat.late_datetime, lat.late_reason, lat.late_min, lat.train_delay_min, tra.train_name, lat.start_time, lat.update_datetime, lat.note FROM madaka.late_his_tbl AS lat INNER JOIN madaka.employee_mst AS emp ON lat.emp_id = emp.emp_id LEFT JOIN madaka.train_mst AS tra ON lat.train_id = tra.train_id WHERE lat.late_id = #{lateId} ORDER BY lat.late_datetime DESC
